behavior: USD estimates from the API are cut to cents, never rounded up
acceptance: estimatedUsdTotal in GET balances and estimatedUsd/receivedUsd/sentUsd in GET balance-history cut to cents (apps/backend/internal/balance/balance.go:127 and history.go:142 use big.Rat.FloatString(2), which rounds); a test with 0.009 USD gives 0.00 and 1.999 gives 1.99; the hero total and the chart's last point then always agree
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: usdString truncates Num*100/Denom with big.Int Quo, correct for zero, sub-cent, large and multi-token sums (cut once after big.Rat sum). Inputs never negative: wallet is ERC20 balanceOf, history balances clamped to 0, wallet_transfers.amount CHECK > 0. Test covers 0.009->0.00 and 1.999999->1.99 via usd(); FloatString would give 0.01/2.00 so it failed before. Backend tests pass.
